Escalation in Tarkov

The military conflict in Tarkov continues to escalate. Eyewitnesses remaining in the city report increasing clashes between BEAR and USEC units. UN forces and the Russian Armed Forces are cordoning off dangerous areas, but these zones are growing, and according to unconfirmed reports, high-level discussions are already underway regarding a potential full lockdown of the city.

Both PMC groups likely still maintain their supply channels for weapons and personnel, which is why almost no one is willing to make optimistic forecasts. Evacuation of civilians is difficult, and both sides are organizing humanitarian aid drops to help local residents hold out until safe corridors open.

Amid the crisis, local criminal groups are also becoming more active. In some cases, these groups manage to seize weapons and take control of parts of the city. Currently, three such areas are known.

In the city center, the criminal gang of a former entrepreneur, known by the alias "Kaban", has established a fortified base in the former LexOs car dealership. According to recent data, PMC units have unsuccessfully attempted to dislodge the gang several times. An anonymous source told the editorial team that Kaban possesses samples of heavy weaponry that cannot even be obtained on the black market. Some experts suggest a possible connection between Kaban and the nonprofit organization "Forward Movement", which was previously linked in a high-profile case involving deputy minister of economy Yaroslav Shkurenko and the criminal authority nicknamed Chepyga.

Near the customs terminal, the "Zavodskoy" gang, previously involved in petty thefts in the district, has been spotted. Eyewitnesses report ongoing gunfire in that area.

EMERCOM units were forced to abandon evacuation points near the "Ultra" mall due to increased attacks by armed groups that took control of one floor of the mall. EMERCOM tents at the nearby highway interchange are no longer safe.

EMERCOM recommendations remain the same: first, find a secure shelter and wait for evacuation there, provide aid to the wounded if possible, and avoid venturing onto city streets. We hope that UN forces and the Russian Armed Forces will take more decisive measures to cool the conflict in Tarkov and will continue reporting all important developments.

Purpose and characteristics
Item #1156 — an aerosol augmenter of radio-frequency electromagnetic emission (RF-EMI), designed to neutralize enemy electronic equipment over a large area. The item can be used on its own or as the warhead component of delivery systems (tactical, operational-tactical, and medium range).
Weight: 37.080 kg
Dimensions: 2500*800*800
Effect radius: 15 to 40 km depending on medium density
Activation:
1. Remote initiation using a timed/distance fuze (up to 200m) /
2. Remote initiation via radio communication (within the radio’s operational range)


General design
The shock-wave emitter operates by means of spherically symmetric compression of the electromagnetic field. The fuze consists of a magnetic system that directs magnetic poles to the center of a sphere formed by two intersecting magnetic flux rings.

Inside the magnetic flux sphere is a detonation distributor, made from a plastic sphere with 45 channels filled with an initiating high explosive (lead azide was tested). The channel system ensures simultaneous arrival of the detonation wave at the main explosive charge.

At the center of the detonation distributor is the main explosive charge (tested mixtures included trotyl-hexogen combinations, octogen, and tetryl). Embedded in the center of the main charge is a cesium iodide single crystal treated with mixture #3012.


Features
Using spherically symmetric compression of the electromagnetic field together with treatment of the cesium iodide single crystal with mixture #3012 provides a significant increase in pulse efficiency compared to known EMI weapon prototypes. Measurements taken during testing showed retention of 40 to 50% of the explosive energy.

And then the Riders of the Arrival shall appear, and they shall open the door to the New World. All that is old shall die, for only the devoted flock is worthy of transformation and service to The Unheard.

The Wardens shall reap the harvest and carry into the New World the memory of old humanity. The transition to the next stage of evolution is inevitable, and the appearance of the Riders marks the beginning of the division of homo sapiens into two kinds.

They shall no longer be united: each shall be shown their place. Only those among us who follow the path laid out by The Unheard shall be permitted to witness the true flourishing of civilization.

to the old world so that from its ashes the New may be born.

Before the face of the coming, fear will compel many to submit to the will of new rulers. But the Rider cannot be deceived. Sunset and dawn, fall and uprising demand Sacrifice! Not become a Sacrifice, but become the executioner’s sword! The weak will perish, and the strong will perish! Only the truly faithful will be allowed to the Door into the future. There, where neurons and bits become one whole.

The Door, the Door, the Door divides past and future, it separates the New and the old world! By the hand of The Unheard it will open, and it will cut away all that is old, all that is needless… The will of The Unheard will determine a new order in which the human species will enter a new phase of development. Phoenix! Rebirth through blood! The new human needs fresh blood!

̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


Thoughts do not burn, the thoughts of Man will remain forever and the Wardens will carry thoughts through the purifying flame of true faith! The Old Man will die. The gods will die. Knowledge will live. Knowledge is more important than the heart! More important than blood!

The pinnacle of evolution turned out to be only a step on the path of humanity’s development, all for the sake of the truth that will be revealed to The Unheard! In the name of truth, kill. The truly faithful understand, the others will burn. The others are destined for pain. All who are not ready to be reborn will drown in the fire of pain. The final threshold. Transformation. Purification.
data.689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page5_Text:
The Priests have access to fragments of The Unheard Knowledge, for they have seen what will be. It was said that the Blue Fire will illuminate our world with a new dawn, and this will be the Dawn of the New World, and then the sacred flame of each was illuminated. The old idols, which humanity followed, lost their former power, and a new order began. The blind burn in the fire of suffering, as foretold, for they do not know the True Path. But the truly faithful turned to the Warden and were promised salvation, for the New Family awaits the New World.

̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


The great transition has begun, and the mighty of this world have become weak, for true power must rise to the top of the Pyramid!

Only Truth will govern the New World, and in its fire, all who cannot grasp it will be consumed. People of the old world see only suffering, but the enlightened see the path and salvation. The blind have turned away from the dawn of the New World, as foretold. They cannot comprehend the blessing of The Unheard Knowledge, and they began to fight to hide the Blue Fire from the world, so that no one would know the Arrival is near!

But they do not know that the Dawn of the New World will cross all boundaries, nor do they know that the truly faithful have seen it from everywhere and have become instruments of The Unheard, for the Arrival cannot be stopped. Where the sun rises, and where it sets, the enlightened have witnessed the great Fire.
data.689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page6_Text:
The truly faithful must follow the Path shown by The Unheard. For anyone can hasten the Arrival. The products of human thought must be gathered in special places, marked by the devoted.

The birth of the New World is preceded by the death of the old. And for this death to occur, The Unheard need instruments through which the great purification of the human race will take place.

̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


But the devoted themselves can become the sword that cleaves a path to the New World. By separating the truly faithful from the doomed, even now we can help The Unheard cleanse the old world. The spilled blood of the blind must become a sign from which others will awaken.

Faith is proven only through blood, pain is the touch of The Unheard, blissful and searing, for only through fire can a mortal be reborn, only with flame is the dead burned away! With Blue Fire! The flame will divide all, the flame will reveal everything, and it will reveal the New World.
data.689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page8_Text:
For those initiated into the plan, The Unheard have prepared a special and singular Path, along which the chosen will be able to enter the New World. Rebirth is ordained for our species, and every new step toward the coming future is marked by the Gift. Each Gift is destined to play its role.

The Blue Fire will become the fire that ignites the entire old world. Dry and dead, the old world must burn to ashes. States will fall, unable to resist the inevitable march of time. The power of rulers will prove to be their curse, for there is no power greater than the power of The Unheard wisdom, and no wisdom higher than the wisdom of The Unheard.

Yet the pinnacle of homo sapien’ history must become the foundation of the New World. All information available to humanity will be sifted through the sieve of the Wardens. Every thought and every action committed by a human will become a cast of the homo sapiens species, for nothing will escape the Eye of the World.

̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


The best that sapiens will leave behind are the pinnacles of thought, which will outlast both this species and this world. Knowledge gave rise to it, and it will also be the engine that will launch a new rebirth. But this time, living thought is destined to become one with artificial thought. True rebirth is a transformation and a merging with a more efficient Higher Mind.

Humanity is incapable, in the truest sense, of mastering time and space. But that which will follow homo sapiens will overcome this limitation as well, for the wisdom of The Unheard will pave the way to the Door, beyond which awaits the New World and the answers to all questions. BLOOD.

Lights of Tarkov
Your daily source of information
̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲

– According to our information, Cobalt has been facing difficulties integrating into Tarkov’s energy infrastructure. Is that true?

– I wouldn’t put it that way. Yes, innovation requires significant energy resources, and our facilities are no exception. Some of our projects demand power plants that simply don’t exist in the region. But the company’s development strategy already includes the construction of next-generation power stations. And we’ve made progress – just two days ago we, hm, reached an agreement with Yaroslav Grigorievich! (editor’s note: Deputy Minister of Economy Shkurenko Y. G.) In the future, Cobalt will bring light to many citizens of Tarkov, and today’s difficulties have only highlighted a problem in the city that we intend to solve.

– So you see the problem as lying with the city, not the costs of your projects? Our data suggests Tarkov has never suffered from a power shortage.

– Are you asking whether our projects can improve the city’s situation? That’s a great question! And I’ll say this: one of the key reasons for choosing this site was its potential for developing energy infrastructure, and in that regard, Tarkov certainly has room to grow. You have to understand – it’s not about what Tarkov looks like now, it’s about what it will become with us.

– Speaking of innovation. We’ve calculated that even taken together, all of Cobalt’s public projects don’t consume that much electricity. It seems Cobalt is planning to increase the city’s power load several times over for a project the people of Tarkov know nothing about. How do you comment on that?

– We understand the public’s concern and appreciate the interest in our work! But right now, even a small leak could seriously affect the development process. The walls have ears, right? Too much openness could harm not only Cobalt, but also Russia’s position on the international market. But getting back to Tarkov and its energy infrastructure – we’ve already reached a compromise with the local authorities. Until our new plants are operational, we’ll be "staying over" at state-owned facilities. For now, we’ll have to squeeze into city power plant buildings, but once our stations come online, the people of Tarkov will forget about power shortages entirely.

– Well, we’re intrigued by Cobalt’s new project and look forward to hearing more. This has been Yuri Belogorov from Lights of Tarkov, and Nikolay Tretyakov, NGO Cobalt representative in Tarkov.

PURPOSE AND CHARACTERISTICS

Automated Radio Relay Service (ARRS) is a system composed of multiple surveillance and communications agents, designed to prepare and control protocols Fortress, Spark, and Obelisk. The list of permitted protocols may be expanded.

The ARRS system is fully autonomous and can operate without external power sources, including under protocol Twilight. If an ARRS agent is disconnected from the network, each module can continue recording for up to 2 years and retain stored data for up to 10 years.

The system supports expansion with additional ARRS modules and automatic updates.

Each ARRS module is equipped with a unique security system (MOU-73S) capable of completely locking the module. Access to a module is possible only with a unique identifier embedded in the senior operator’s key.



GENERAL DESIGN

The ARRS system has no single control center. Each ARRS module locally stores the following data:
1) Scripts required for the module’s autonomous operation
2) Scripts for verifying user access level and transmitting data according to protocol The Eye (HGL-01E)
3) Archive of recordings for the entire observation history
4) Scripts to initiate protocol Warden (JKL-13R)

Module preparation and assembly are carried out according to the instructions described in Appendix 17 (TUR-09L).

ARRS modules operate on a closed infrastructure. The model, methods, and architectural requirements are described in Appendix 21 (UTE-99Y).

THE NINTH CIRCLE
̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


The Will of Chance

Greetings to all survivors. I don’t know what I’d do without being able to talk to you. Sometimes it even feels like the old world never existed, as if everything collapsed into this closed-off city where each of us has just one mission – to make it through to tomorrow.

But today, I want to share a story that gives me hope for a better outcome. Maybe it will help you too.

Yesterday I went to check on a wounded friend and met a gloomy, withdrawn BEAR sitting in Therapist’s recovery room, clutching a USEC patch in his hands. At first glance, it seemed obvious: a trophy from a heavy fight where he lost a comrade. He’d avenged him, sure, but that hadn’t brought him peace. So there he sat, angry at himself for not being able to double-tap that USEC in time. Still, I decided to strike up a conversation, and from his first words, I realized all my guesses were wrong.

This BEAR had been scouting a new route to TerraGroup’s underground lab when his squad discovered an elevator shaft in critical condition. They managed to reach the complex through it and complete their mission, but on the way back, Raiders pinned them down hard.

During the retreat, the shaft collapsed, burying the entire team except for our guy. He himself was pinned against a wall by a support beam. The surface was just a couple hundred meters away, but without help, he had no chance of making it out alive. So he decided to hold on as long as he could.

Two days later, he heard footsteps approaching. He recognized English speech, but by then he couldn’t even hold his pistol, let alone put up a fight. He saw a flashlight beam sweep the tunnel ahead and braced himself for the end.

But instead of a gunshot, he heard a safety click, followed by careful steps. The newcomer wasn’t an enemy, but an ally. The stranger helped him get free, but the effort triggered heavy bleeding that his exhausted body couldn’t handle.

What happened next he remembers only in fragments, drifting in and out of consciousness. All his strength went into holding onto that USEC, and at some point, he accidentally tore the patch off the stranger’s shoulder.

He woke up in Therapist’s care, never finding out who had pulled him from the rubble. All he had left was the patch, which he now keeps with him.

We often convince ourselves that we’re in control, but most things around us are shaped by forces we can’t predict – a lucky weather break during retreat, a weapon jam in the enemy’s hands, or the will of a random passerby.

To everyone reading this: I wish you hope for a better outcome, even when everything seems set against you.

That’s all for now. Stay alive till tomorrow.

Down the Untrodden Paths

I welcome my readers once again. The Contract Wars have forever changed Tarkov’s landscape, and knowing the terrain often means the difference between life and death. Many turn to Jaeger for help, but the forester’s experience is of little use in urban areas or on the outskirts.

Some of you may have heard of the Mushroom Picker who roams across the city, though few have ever met him in person. At one point, both the military and the Scavs were hunting the reclusive old man. It’s said the Mushroom Picker has no ties to TerraGroup and has never even held a weapon. Still, many would pay a fortune to have him on their side.

That’s because the old man knows routes and passages that no one has walked, even in peaceful times. Somehow, the Mushroom Picker manages to avoid army checkpoints, not to mention Scav camps. With knowledge like that, he can seriously affect the balance of power in Tarkov.

Yet no one has ever truly understood his motives or goals. The more devout citizens like to tell stories of his night-time encounters with witnesses of the Arrival. To be honest, I don’t rule anything out anymore.

Despite his murky nature, the Mushroom Picker sometimes appears to those who’ve lost their way. I personally know several people, and they share nothing in common: he’s helped mercenaries from both PMCs, civilians, and even Scavs.

Whatever moral compass guides this eccentric wanderer, his help is not something one can count on. A meeting with the Mushroom Picker only happens when he wills it.

That’s all for now. Stay alive till tomorrow.

During the reporting period 14 groups of test subjects were examined at the site. Each group contained between 5 and 25 people depending on the experimental conditions. Some experiments could not be carried out due to the site’s limited capabilities. Group 9 was redirected to Site Theta because of the risk of contamination and the poor containment of the “Labyrinth” premises. Group 1 had to be neutralized entirely for similar reasons.

However, most experiments proved effective and provided the material and conclusions required by the laboratories and other test sites. Studies were conducted on effects on the human body and on expanding physical capabilities. Work proceeded along three directions:
1) Increasing organism endurance under various conditions.
2) Testing the effects of experimental biological compounds on the human body.
3) Developing compounds capable of affecting the human mental state.



Increasing organism endurance under various conditions.
During the study, subjects were placed in various conditions (food deprivation, prolonged confinement in a restricted space, blood loss exceeding 20/30/40% of total blood volume, burns with ITP from 50 to 95 points, acute and subacute intoxication).

Compounds SJ6, eTG-c, and SJ1 demonstrated significant effectiveness in stabilizing condition and activating the organism’s reserve resources in poisoning of varying severity and intoxication in the presence of open wounds. Compounds SJ15 and M.U.L.E. demonstrated high effectiveness under favorable conditions and increased subjects’ activity periods by 47–60%.

As a result of the studies, eTG-c, SJ6, and SJ15 are recommended for further iteration and development. The lack of professional training among test subjects negatively affected research results, therefore when used on trained combat personnel, the projected effect may reach higher results. Field testing is required.
data.68d2fdbbf8817df4690db3d5_Note_Page2_Text:

Testing the effects of experimental biological compounds on the human body.
Extensive testing of already developed combat stimulants was carried out according to the established plan.

Compounds P22 and M.U.L.E. exhibited critical side effects with regular use. Subjects were diagnosed with muscle tissue atrophy and, in isolated cases, paralysis or necrosis of individual muscles (3% of subjects). The research group associates these effects with excessive wear of muscle tissue and the organism’s inability to recover after such pressure. It is recommended to develop an advanced version of these compounds in which, after administration of the functional composition, a restorative mixture is also administered to replace expended physiological resources.

Development of a new formulation of the compound Zagustin continues. Formulations that thinned the blood immediately after the action of the primary mixture were tested, but subjects exhibited symptoms similar to hemophilia. None of these subjects had a genetic predisposition to hemophilia, therefore the search for a more suitable formulation continues. In parallel a Zagustin-based compound with reduced effect on profibrinolysin activators is being developed. At present, Zagustin use is NOT RECOMMENDED due to an increased risk of thrombosis and stroke in the majority of subjects.



Developing compounds capable of affecting the human mental state.
The study did not confirm the possibility of deliberately inducing specific psychoses in subjects. Genetics and personal experience of subjects determined individual risk factors that limit the influence of specific compounds.

Therefore a proposal emerged to develop, instead of receptor-targeted action, a compound that can influence the target’s central nervous system and cause the development of the psychoses to which the target has the greatest predisposition.

Under the supervision of Voronenko N. V., two iterations of a general-purpose compound were tested. At present there is a problem with stabilizing the compound, and tests confirmed subject resistance to the compound. Deeper genomic study of subjects is required to identify

According to the plan, the group was to withdraw and report mission failure. However, the commander (callsign Voevoda) chose to continue the search and successfully identified the asset’s new location.

From Mar. 26 to Mar. 27, the Bogatyr squad conducted surveillance on the convoy transporting the target and prepared for an assault. On Mar. 27, the asset was captured. Report


On Jan. 2, the Bogatyr squad carried out a hostage evacuation from the Tarbank branch on Korablestroiteley Street. The enemy had taken up firing positions on the 1st and 2nd floors. Hostages were sheltered in the reception area on the 1st floor.

A direct assault was ruled out to minimize risk to the hostages. I decided to clear the building with two teams. The first team (call signs: Moreman, Kaskad) ascended to the 2nd floor using climbing gear and engaged the enemy utilizing smoke grenades.

Meanwhile, the main assault team (call signs: Voevoda, Taran, Vityaz), under sniper overwatch (call sign: Strelets), attacked the enemy on the 1st floor and extracted the hostages. The operation was completed swiftly, no hostages were injured. Fourteen targets were neutralized, presumably members of Kaban's criminal gang. No casualties in the Bogatyr squad.

The operation drew attention from nearby USEC forces and local civilians, and the squad had to repel enemy attacks twice during the withdrawal. After handing over the freed hostages to Russian Armed Forces, the Bogatyr squad will relocate from its previous bases to the Carousel outpost to await further instructions.

Bogatyr squad commander

An EMP (electromagnetic pulse) is used in electromagnetic weaponry (EMW).

An EMP is designed to disable electrical and electronic equipment and disrupt communication channels.

The consequences of an EMP strike include the total failure of all unshielded equipment.

SITUATION REPORT

Armed clashes between criminal groups in the Tarkov suburbs have become increasingly frequent in recent weeks. This morning, the Ministry of Internal Affairs for Tarkov issued a press release following multiple citizen inquiries.

While the investigation remains ongoing, ministry representatives confirmed a number of established facts regarding criminal activity in the Tarkov and Norvinsk districts.

According to available data, the recent crime wave is tied to escalating conflict between several organizations, one of which, led by the crime boss known as Arseny Petrovich Chepygin, is rapidly expanding its influence.

Chepygin’s group has grown more aggressive over the past six months, consolidating control over new territories. The reasons for this sudden power shift remain unclear, but it’s evident that without serious backing, the gang could not have achieved such success.

The question of who this mysterious “investor” might be, and what their motives are, remains open. We’ll continue to follow the situation closely.

data.69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page1_Text:
12.11.
Got out of Stockholm without any trouble. But during the layover the whole place turned into a complete fucking shitshow. Not only did they pull the entire crew off the ship and slow all work onboard to a crawl, they wouldn’t even let us stand nearby. And for what? With paranoia like that no wonder Terragroup rotates crews on the icebreaker so often. Short-ass contracts, all these fucked protocols, all this secrecy bullshit… nobody’d put up with this crap if the pay wasn’t insane.

And I even managed to sneak a look at the loading op. They got people running back and forth nonstop and all they’re loading is crates full of electronics. Even the dockworkers are their own guys. Nobody GIVES A FUCK about your electronics, we’ve carried worse at sea! Arrogant fucking asshole fucks.

20.11
Made it to Tarkov, which means Saint Petersburg’s close now. Just hope we don’t get stuck here too like we did in Stockholm. Almost home.
data.69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page2_Text:
09.12
Wow what great fucking luck. They delayed the stopover while we were already approaching Tarkov, then canceled the whole thing completely. Heard something serious happened with Terragroup in the city, maybe even a shootout or some shit. If even half of it’s true, we’re gonna be sitting here for a long damn time.

15.01
Knew right away this was going to turn into a disaster… We’re fucked, royally. Orders came down from above to drop anchor and wait for further instructions and meanwhile everything in Tarkov just keeps getting worse. Alex says UN troops’ll enter the city soon and everything’ll calm down. Yeah, sure. Fucking sure it will…

3.06
Still no orders. Comms started acting up too. Usually at least you know when your contract ends, but here you just sit around losing your damn mind. Max’s family in Tarkov saw military vehicles in the streets. Maybe our guys’ll finally get shit under control??
data.69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page3_Text:
April
Thought I’d never even find this notebook again. And sure as hell never thought I’d end up trapped on this goddamn icebreaker for years. Fucking blockade… And that bastard Altman deserves worse than death!

Yes the boys broke. We should’ve called for evacuation a long damn time ago! Maybe a year back those USECs still could’ve smuggled us across the cordon. Obvious enough command stopped giving a shit about us the second troops rolled into the city.

But no. Altman’s precious materials matter more than actual living people whose brains are already melting in this frozen hell!
data.69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page4_Text:
And the captain’s no better, completely lost his fucking mind over somebody breaking radio silence…

At least now there’s maybe some hope they’ll get us outta here. And when we finally make it out I’m burning this fucking diary to ashes.

9/12/11
4:19 PM

Following the incident at the TerraGroup main office in Tarkov, orders were issued to prepare
Operation “Firefly”. The arrival of the container ships Kairo Nexus and Pacific Axis is
expected within a week. All small craft required for the landing operation are already
positioned in the waters off Tarkov.

Eastern Energy is currently docked in the port of Saint Petersburg awaiting the order to
initiate the operation.

Pacific Axis has confirmed the presence of the following cargo categories and units on
board:
- LV type containers (light transport, civilian vehicles)
- VM type containers (repair vehicles and maintenance equipment)
- CM type containers (generators, camouflage nets, tents, heating stations, etc.)
- CF type containers (communications equipment, radio-technical systems,
electronics, surveillance equipment, encryption and intelligence equipment, etc.)
- Fuel tank containers (IBC tanks)
- LAV armored personnel carriers (12 units)
- M1128 fire support vehicles (5 units)
- Tigr armored vehicles (20 units)
- Personnel (300 total)

Kairo Nexus has confirmed the presence of the following cargo categories and units on
board:
- A/M type containers (ammunition for primary calibers and weapons systems, mines,
etc.)
- FS type containers (provisions for personnel)
- MS type containers (medical equipment, instruments, etc.)
- BM type containers (generators, camouflage nets, tents, heating stations, etc.)

- MB type containers (light watercraft)
- Personnel (1200 total)


27/12/11
11:47 AM

Kairo Nexus, Pacific Axis, and the small craft have taken their designated positions. Ice
cover is minimal and does not impede vessel movement.

The reconnaissance team (commander callsign Knight) deployed from Pacific Axis have
successfully landed on the coast in the lighthouse peninsula area and established
observation and communications posts.

VEIL (Vectorized Exo-atmospheric Intelligence Lattice) Satellite
Network Readiness


The project to establish the VEIL orbital satellite network has reached its final construction
stage. Integration of the satellites in the Lambda sector completed the orbital network,
providing full coverage of the northern regions of Europe and Asia as well as the entire
territories of both American continents.

Despite the project nearing completion, the suspension of TerraGroup’s public humanitarian
and scientific programs, as well as those of its subsidiaries related to ground and orbital
network infrastructure, is not recommended. At this stage it is essential to minimize
external attention from government authorities and the press. I recommend continuing all
projects regardless of the cost of these investments. All associated expenses will be
included in the VEIL project budget.

In its current configuration, the VEIL system allows interception of signals across its entire
coverage area and their seamless substitution, as well as the ability to simulate
transmissions from specific senders, including government agencies of individual countries.
In most sectors it is also possible to temporarily suppress any communications systems.
(Satellites in the Upsilon and Delta sectors are still undergoing modernization and currently
do not provide this capability.)

Separately addressing the concerns raised by Ms. McRory: detection of the network by
external means is practically impossible due to our modernization of the satellite hardware
and the integration of officially decommissioned satellites into the network.
Intelligence methods can only detect fragmented satellite coverage belonging to TerraGroup,
which is insufficient to raise suspicion among journalists or intelligence services.
Potential risks are associated only with TerraGroup’s public activities, particularly their abrupt
termination or deviations from declared plans for public scientific and humanitarian projects.

Integration of the ARRS network with VEIL is proceeding according to schedule. Only final
testing remains, after which system access and control of VEIL via ARRS terminals will be
possible using the appropriate access codes. Access codes will be distributed individually
through the VEIL system.

Immediately after full deployment, the project’s scientific team will be reassigned to the
development of the first prototypes of incoherent wireless transmission (IWT) equipment.

P. Wilson

data.5447a9cd4bdc2dbd208b4567 Description:
The Colt M4A1 carbine is a fully automatic variant of the basic M4 Carbine and was primarily designed for special operations use.
However, U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) was soon to adopt the M4A1 for almost all special operations units, followed later by general introduction of the M4A1 into service with the U.S. Army and Marine Corps.
data.5447ac644bdc2d6c208b4567 Description: A pack of 5.56x45 mm M855 ammo, 50 rounds.
data.5448ba0b4bdc2d02308b456c Description: A somewhat fragile factory emergency exit door key.
data.5448bd6b4bdc2dfc2f8b4569 Description: The time-proven PM pistol (Pistolét Makárova - "Makarov Pistol", GAU Index - 56-A-125). Due to the ubiquitous spread of both the pistol and its ammunition, as well as its exceptional reliability, light weight, and compact size, the PM still sees wide service in both police, military, and security forces. Although the damage makes you wish for the best.
data.5448be9a4bdc2dfd2f8b456a Description: RGD-5 (GAU index - 57-G-717) is an antipersonnel fragmentation time-delayed offensive hand grenade. The grenade's UZRGM fuze insures a time delay of 3.2 - 4.2 seconds. Due to the offensive type of the grenade, its fragments are relatively light and have a smaller dispersion radius.
data.5448c12b4bdc2d02308b456f Description: A standard 8-round magazine for IzhMekh-produced Makarov PM pistols. It features a side observation slot for checking the magazine capacity.
data.5448c1d04bdc2dff2f8b4569 Description: The PMAG 20 GEN M3 is a 20-round 5.56x45 NATO (.223 Remington) polymer magazine for AR-15/M4 compatible weapons.
data.5448fee04bdc2dbc018b4567 Description: A 0.6 liter bottle of water. The bottle itself might be a bit dirty, but the water is clean. Hopefully.
data.5448ff904bdc2d6f028b456e Description: A small pack of saltine crackers usually found in Russian army combat rations.
data.5449016a4bdc2d6f028b456f Description: A few notes of the still-valued Russian rouble.
data.544909bb4bdc2d6f028b4577 Description: The Advanced Target Pointer Illuminator Aiming Laser (ATPIAL) produced by L3 Technologies is a rugged, combat-proven and easy-to-use aiming system with integrated infrared and visible aim lasers as well as an infrared illuminator.
data.54491bb74bdc2d09088b4567 Description: Following on from the successful FULCRUM knife, Extrema Ratio developed a bayonet version of that design. Like the original FULCRUM, this bayonet is extremely versatile and strong. The tanto-shaped blade allows for large amounts of work and wear while still keeping a sharp edge at its exceedingly sturdy tip. This feature, combined with a sharp false edge, makes the knife retain sufficient combat penetration capability to engage targets covered in heavy clothing, padding, or soft ballistic protections. Thanks to its weight and top-heavy balancing, the FULCRUM BAYONET blade is suitable for hard work on the field.
data.54491c4f4bdc2db1078b4568 Description: The MP-133 is a multi-shot pump-action shotgun produced by IzhMekh. It is the evolution of the earlier IZh-81 pump-action shotgun and is intended primarily for civilian and security markets.
data.544a11ac4bdc2d470e8b456a Description: A small secure container used by PMCs formerly deployed in Tarkov.
data.544a378f4bdc2d30388b4567 Name: AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 40 GEN M3 STANAG 40-round magazine
data.544a378f4bdc2d30388b4567 Description: The PMAG 40 GEN M3 is a 40-round 5.56x45 NATO (.223 Remington) polymer magazine for AR-15/M4 compatible weapons.
data.544a37c44bdc2d25388b4567 Description: A 60-round 5.56x45 SureFire MAG5-60 metal high capacity magazine.
data.544a38634bdc2d58388b4568 Name: AR-15 Colt USGI A2 5.56x45 flash hider
data.544a38634bdc2d58388b4568 Description: The 5.56x45 Colt USGI A2 flash hider (a.k.a. Bird Cage) is designed for mounting on 5.56x45 weapons built on the AR-15 system. However, it can be installed on other weapons of the same caliber provided that barrel has the same threading for muzzle devices. A service muzzle device for M4A1.
data.544a3a774bdc2d3a388b4567 Name: Leupold Mark 4 HAMR 4x24 DeltaPoint hybrid assault scope
data.544a3a774bdc2d3a388b4567 Description: The Hybrid Leupold-produced scope comprises of the Mark 4 HAMR 4x24mm optical sight with the DeltaPoint reflex sight installed on top of it. It was developed for precision mid-range carbine fire using the 4x optics while being equally effective in close quarters thanks to use of compact reflex sight when necessary.
data.544a5caa4bdc2d1a388b4568 Name: Crye Precision AVS plate carrier (Ranger Green)
data.544a5caa4bdc2d1a388b4568 Description: The Crye Precision AVS plate carrier equipped with Groin Protector and pouches in assault configuration. One of the most comfortable to wear plate carriers.
data.544a5cde4bdc2d39388b456b Description: An extra durable backpack made from 1000D Cordura with a separate pocket for a water bladder and a MOLLE attachment system on the sides.
data.544fb25a4bdc2dfb738b4567 Description: The most common gauze bandage, autoclaved and aseptic.
data.544fb3364bdc2d34748b456a Description: A common splint for fixing damaged bones in place.
data.544fb37f4bdc2dee738b4567 Description: The cheapest and most widely available Metamizole painkillers.
data.544fb3f34bdc2d03748b456a Description: A single-use syringe full of morphine. A powerful drug, used primarily to treat both acute and chronic severe pain.
data.544fb45d4bdc2dee738b4568 Description: A first aid kit containing a bivibag, various types of bandages, and dressing tools.
data.544fb5454bdc2df8738b456a Description: With this compact and versatile multitool there is no need to be worried about having no tools on you at the right time.
data.544fb62a4bdc2dfb738b4568 Name: Pack of Russian Army pineapple juice
data.544fb62a4bdc2dfb738b4568 Description: "Russian Army" reconstituted pineapple juice. It's hard to imagine a better source of carbs and vitamins under blockade conditions.
data.544fb6cc4bdc2d34748b456e Description: A sweet nutritional bar for a quick bite. Well balanced in proteins, fiber, and vitamins, but a bit over the top in sweetness.
data.54527a984bdc2d4e668b4567 Description: A 5.56x45mm NATO M855 cartridge with a 4 gram bullet with a steel penetrator tip over a lead core with a copper jacket in a brass case. This cartridge was designed in the 1980s as the equivalent to the FN SS109 cartridge for the 5.56x45mm NATO caliber armament used by the United States Army. Thanks to its design, the bullet in this cartridge is capable of piercing through basic ballistic protection equipment, as well as certain intermediate protection equipment, however, it has a high probability of rebound on various surfaces.
data.54527ac44bdc2d36668b4567 Description: A 5.56x45mm NATO M855A1 cartridge with a 4 gram armor-piercing bullet with a steel penetrator tip over a copper alloy core with a copper semi-jacket in a brass case. This cartridge was designed to improve the penetration capabilities of the 5.56x45mm NATO M855 cartridge of the United States Army, being able to pierce basic and intermediate body ballistic protections, however, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability on various surfaces.
data.545cdae64bdc2d39198b4568 Description: A Mid-sized versatile assault pack. Spacious, sturdy and comfortable, this backpack is loved both by military and hikers worldwide. 34L of total space, a hydration system, easy access to side pockets, near-perfect suspension, and a MOLLE attachment system make it a great choice for up to 72 hours of autonomous hiking... or carrying a good load of loot.
data.545cdb794bdc2d3a198b456a Description: The 6B43 bulletproof vest is designed for protection from light weapon bullets - including BP and PP - fragments of grenades, mines, and melee weapons, as well as reducing the risk of after-penetration effects during combat situations.
data.557ff21e4bdc2d89578b4586 Description: A pair of commonplace tactical glasses with glare and impact protection.
data.5580169d4bdc2d9d138b4585 Description: A 510mm long 12 gauge barrel for the MP-43-1C double-barrelled shotgun.
data.55801eed4bdc2d89578b4588 Description: The SV-98 is a Russian sniper rifle developed in 1998-2000 by a group of weapon engineers led by V. Stronskiy and serially produced by IzhMash group. It is a magazine-fed bolt-action rifle, designed to engage the military personnel at the distances of up to 1000m.
data.5580223e4bdc2d1c128b457f Description: A hunter's dream. A classic double-barrelled beauty, simple and elegant. Fed with 12 gauge shells.
data.558022b54bdc2dac148b458d Description: The EOTech EXPS3-0 holographic sight. Thanks to design features it can be used with a wide range of weapons, even with non-folding sights. Compatible with night vision devices when using the NV reticle mode. Utilized by US SOCOM as a sight for operations in confined spaces.
data.55802d5f4bdc2dac148b458e Name: AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 W STANAG 30-round magazine
data.55802d5f4bdc2dac148b458e Description: A 30-round 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG GEN M3 30 polymer magazine with an observation slot for faster capacity checking.
data.55802f5d4bdc2dac148b458f Description: The polymer Magpul MOE (Magpul Original Equipment) pistol grip can be installed on any weapon compatible with AR-15 pistol grips. Thanks to the ergonomic shape and anti-slip texture, it makes the weapon grip and control more comfortably. The inside of the grip contains free space for spare parts, tools, batteries, and an accessories kit.
data.558032614bdc2de7118b4585 Description: The TangoDown Stubby BGV-MK46K tactical grip is a short grip for use with weapons in close and extra close quarters combat. It ideally fits assault shotguns and also contains a compartment for batteries or SPTA. Black version.
data.559ba5b34bdc2d1f1a8b4582 Description: A standard Izhmash-produced polymer magazine for the SV-98 7.62x54R sniper rifle.
data.55d355e64bdc2d962f8b4569 Description: An upper receiver for the M4A1 assault rifle manufactured by Colt. Equipped with a mount for attaching additional devices.
data.55d35ee94bdc2d61338b4568 Description: A 10.3 inch (260mm) barrel for AR-15 platform weapons for 5.56x45 NATO ammo. Corresponds with standard service M4 CQBR barrel.
data.55d3632e4bdc2d972f8b4569 Description: A 14.5 inch (370mm) barrel for AR-15 platform weapons for 5.56x45 NATO ammo. Corresponds with standard service M4A1 barrel.
data.55d447bb4bdc2d892f8b456f Description: A 725mm long 12 gauge barrel for the MP-43-1C double-barrelled shotgun.
data.55d448594bdc2d8c2f8b4569 Description: A standard factory-produced 610mm barrel for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.55d4491a4bdc2d882f8b456e Description: A standard factory-produced 510mm barrel for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.55d449444bdc2d962f8b456d Description: A standard factory-produced 610mm barrel with a wide upper rib for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.55d44fd14bdc2d962f8b456e Description: A standard charging handle for AR-15 and compatible systems, manufactured by Colt.
data.55d459824bdc2d892f8b4573 Description: Knight's Armament Company RIS is a standard service handguard for the M4A1 carbines, but it can be installed on most AR-15 based weapons, provided that the barrel is the right length. It comes equipped with 4 mounts for the installation of a heat shield and additional accessories.
data.55d45d3f4bdc2d972f8b456c Description: A standard Izhmekh-manufactured forestock, designed for MP-133 shotguns and made out of beechwood.
data.55d45f484bdc2d972f8b456d Name: MP-133 custom plastic forestock with rails
data.55d45f484bdc2d972f8b456d Description: A nonstandard polymer forestock for MP-133 pump-action shotguns, manufactured by an unknown third-party producer. Equipped with 2 short and 1 long mount for installation of additional equipment.
data.55d480c04bdc2d1d4e8b456a Description: A 30-round polymer Izhmash 6L23 magazine for 5.45x39 ammo, for AK-74 and compatible systems.
data.55d481904bdc2d8c2f8b456a Description: A 45-round 5.45x39 polymer Izhmash 6L26 magazine for AK-74 and compatible systems.
data.55d482194bdc2d1d4e8b456b Description: A 60-round 5.45x39 quad-stack polymer Izhmash 6L31 magazine for AK-74 and compatible systems. Produced in a small batch, never serialized.
data.55d4837c4bdc2d1d4e8b456c Description: A 10-round 5.45x39 Izhmash polymer magazine Saiga 545, for the AK-based civilian carbine of the same name.
data.55d484b44bdc2d1d4e8b456d Description: A 6-shell capacity 12 gauge tube magazine by Izhmekh, for MP-133 shotguns.
data.55d485804bdc2d8c2f8b456b Description: An 8-shell capacity 12 gauge tube magazine by Izhmekh, for MP-133 shotguns.
data.55d485be4bdc2d962f8b456f Description: A makeshift 84-round PM magazine. First assembled by an unknown genius by combining PM and PPSH magazines into a single design for operations in narrow spaces with the aid of ballistic shields. Although it was never serialized even in the smallest number, it can be crafted pretty easily, provided you have the donor mags and skillful hands.
data.55d4887d4bdc2d962f8b4570 Description:
A 30-round metal Colt AR-15 magazine designed in compliance with the STANAG 4179 standard for 5.56x45 ammo.
The STANAG 4179 standard was approved by NATO members in 1980 for the unification of allied personnel ammo and magazines.
data.55d48a634bdc2d8b2f8b456a Name: Kiba Arms SPRM rail mount for pump-action shotguns
data.55d48a634bdc2d8b2f8b456a Description: The universal SPRM 13-position rail mount by Kiba Arms International, for attaching additional devices to pump-action shotguns.
data.55d48ebc4bdc2d8c2f8b456c Name: Delta-Tek Sprut mount for pump-action shotguns
data.55d48ebc4bdc2d8c2f8b456c Description: The Delta-Tek Sprut mount was developed to install on tube magazines of pump-action shotguns like the MP-133, MP-153, MP-135, Benelli M2, Winchester 1300, and so on. It features 3 Weaver mounts for the attachment of additional devices.
data.55d4ae6c4bdc2d8b2f8b456e Description: The High Standard M4SS telescoping stock closely follows the classic M4A1 stock except for a few geometry details.
data.55d4af3a4bdc2d972f8b456f Name: AR-15 Leapers UTG Low Profile A2 front sight
data.55d4af3a4bdc2d972f8b456f Description: The UTG Low Profile A2 front sight, installed on the Windham Weaponry gas block. Manufactured by Leapers Inc.
data.55d4b9964bdc2d1d4e8b456e Description: The Colt A2 polymer pistol grip can be installed on any weapon compatible with AR-15 grips. Standard-issue for all AR-15-based weapons of US Army and USMC.
data.55d5f46a4bdc2d1b198b4567 Description: The Colt A2 detachable rear sight. Standard-issue for M4A1 assault rifles.
data.55d614004bdc2d86028b4568 Description: The SureFire SOCOM556-MONSTER 5.56x45 and .223 sound suppressor, can only be installed on compatible SureFire muzzle devices.
data.55d6190f4bdc2d87028b4567 Description: The SureFire SOCOM556-MINI MONSTER 5.56x45 and .223 sound suppressor is a shorter version of the SOCOM556-MONSTER. Can only be installed on compatible SureFire muzzle devices.
data.55f84c3c4bdc2d5f408b4576 Name: AR-15 Daniel Defense RIS II 9.5 handguard (Coyote Brown)
data.55f84c3c4bdc2d5f408b4576 Description: The Daniel Defense RIS II 9.5 foregrip is a part of the SOPMOD Block II program to replace the standard M4CQBR or Mk18 foregrips in the US SOCOM service. Made with light but durable aircraft aluminum alloy. Equipped with 4 mounts for installation of additional devices and accessories.
data.560835c74bdc2dc8488b456f Description: A standard factory-produced 510mm barrel with a wide upper rib for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.560836484bdc2d20478b456e Description: A standard factory-produced 540mm barrel for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.560836b64bdc2d57468b4567 Description: A standard factory-produced 540mm barrel with a wide upper rib for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.560836fb4bdc2d773f8b4569 Description: A standard factory-produced 660mm barrel for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.560837154bdc2da74d8b4568 Description: A standard factory-produced 660mm barrel with a wide upper rib for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.5608373c4bdc2dc8488b4570 Description: A standard factory-produced 710mm barrel for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.560837544bdc2de22e8b456e Description: A standard factory-produced 710mm barrel with a wide upper rib for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.560837824bdc2d57468b4568 Description: A standard factory-produced 750mm barrel for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.5608379a4bdc2d26448b4569 Description: A standard factory-produced 750mm barrel with a wide upper rib for MP-133 12 gauge shotguns.
data.560838c94bdc2d77798b4569 Description: Remington Tactical Choke 12ga is designed specifically for use on tactical shotguns and home-defense shotguns. Combines the properties of both cylinder and flash hider.
data.56083a334bdc2dc8488b4571 Description: A plastic pistol grip for MP-133 and MP-153 shotguns to replace the standard stock, manufactured by Izhmekh.
data.56083be64bdc2d20478b456f Description: A plastic stock for MP-133 and MP-153 shotguns with a rubber butt-plate manufactured by Izhmekh.
data.56083cba4bdc2de22e8b456f Description: A wooden stock for MP-133 and MP-153 shotguns with a rubber butt-plate manufactured by Izhmekh.
data.56083e1b4bdc2dc8488b4572 Description: A standard-issue rear sight for the SV-98 sniper rifle, manufactured by Izhmash.
data.56083eab4bdc2d26448b456a Description: An anti-heat ribbon for the SV-98 sniper rifle. Applied to the barrel. Prevents hot air from rising directly from the barrel and creating optical distortions in the line of fire.
data.560d5e524bdc2d25448b4571 Description: A 12/70 buckshot shell for 12 gauge shotguns.
data.560d61e84bdc2da74d8b4571 Description: A 7.62x54mm R SNB gzh (GRAU Index - 7N14) cartridge with a 9.8 gram armor-piercing bullet with a pointed heat-strengthened steel core over a lead base with a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. This SNB cartridge (SNíperskiy s Bronebóynoy púley - "Sniper with Armor-piercing bullet") was developed in the mid-1990s as a modernization of the 7.62x54mm R PS gzh cartridge to improve its penetration capabilities when fired from a sniper or designated marksman rifles, managing of piercing specialized ballistic body protections as well as providing a significant stopping power effect.
data.560d657b4bdc2da74d8b4572 Description: An underbarrel-mounted LED flashlight "Klesch-2P + LAM" manufactured by Zenit.
data.560d75f54bdc2da74d8b4573 Name: 7.62x54mm R SNB gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
data.560e620e4bdc2d724b8b456b Description: A standard-issue muzzle device for the SV-98 bolt-action sniper rifle.
data.5644bd2b4bdc2d3b4c8b4572 Description: AK-74N (Avtomat Kalashnikova 74 Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 Night") was developed in 1970 by M. T. Kalashnikov, became a further evolution of AKM due to adoption of the new 5.45x39 ammunition by the military. The key design difference from the standard AK-74 is a side mount for optical and night scopes.
data.5645bc214bdc2d363b8b4571 Description: The FORT Kiver-M bulletproof helmets are designed for use by officers of special law enforcement agencies of the Russian Federation.
data.5645bcc04bdc2d363b8b4572 Description: The ComTac II amplifies low-level sounds while suppressing impulse noises. Water resistant for outdoor usage. Manufactured by Peltor.
data.5648a69d4bdc2ded0b8b457b Description: A custom-made chest rig for wearing on top of body armor in urban operations. Sturdy and versatile, it features both MOLLE and ALICE attachment systems.
data.5648a7494bdc2d9d488b4583 Description: A light but durable and reliable body armor protecting only the vital areas.
data.5648ac824bdc2ded0b8b457d Description: The RP-1 charging handle by Zenit is a milled detail, manufactured with D16T aluminum alloy with black coating. It's compatible with all models of AK family rifles. The RP-1 is larger and more convenient than the standard charging handle, which improves the weapon ergonomics and makes handling more comfortable. The RP-1 is installed above the base handle through kit-enclosed bolts. © Zenit
data.5648ae314bdc2d3d1c8b457f Description: The RS47 lightweight polymer handguard, fits the majority of rifles and carbines built on the base of AK-family rifles. Equipped with two short and two long rail mounts for installing additional devices. Manufactured by Command Arms.
data.5648b0744bdc2d363b8b4578 Description: A standard Izhmash-produced 6P20 Sb.6 wooden handguard for AK-74 assault rifles.
data.5648b1504bdc2d9d488b4584 Description: A 6P20 Sb.9 polymer handguard for AK-74M automatic rifles which replaced the classic wooden one. Manufactured by Izhmash.
data.5648b4534bdc2d3d1c8b4580 Name: AK Zenit B-10M handguard with B-19 upper mount
data.5648b4534bdc2d3d1c8b4580 Description: The integrally machined B-10M handguard is manufactured from D16T aluminum alloy with black coating and can be installed instead of the standard-issue handguard on AK series 103, 104, 105, 74S, 74M, AKM, and AKMS. B-19 rail mount is basically a sight mount hovering over the gas tube. Also integrally machined from D16T aluminum alloy with black coating, it can be installed on B-10M or B-21M foregrips. ©Zenit
data.5649a2464bdc2d91118b45a8 Description: A universal mount by NcStar that allows installing an auxiliary sight at 45 degrees angle.
data.5649aa744bdc2ded0b8b457e Description: A standard Izhmash-produced 6P20 0-20 muzzle brake and compensator for the AK-74 and weapon systems based on it.
data.5649ab884bdc2ded0b8b457f Description: The DTK-1 muzzle brake-compensator by Zenit is designed to be installed on 7.62x39 and 5.45x39 AK-based weapon systems. data.56dfef82d2720bbd668b4567 Description: A 5.45x39mm BP gs (GRAU Index - 7N22) cartridge with a 3.7 gram armor-piercing bullet with a hardened carbon steel core with lead cladding on the tip and bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. This BP bullet (Bronebóynaya Púlya - "Armor-piercing Bullet") was developed by TsNIITochMash in 1998 based on the 5.45x39mm PP gs cartridge to improve its design and penetration capabilities, resulting in an improvement at piercing some intermediate models of body ballistic protection, however, due to its design, it has a significant bounce probability off various surfaces.
data.56dff026d2720bb8668b4567 Description: A 5.45x39mm BS gs (GRAU Index - 7N24) cartridge with a 4.1 gram armor-piercing bullet with a pointed tungsten carbide core over a lead base with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. This BS bullet (Broneboynyy Serdechnik - "Armor-piercing Core") was developed by TsNIITochMash in 1998 to greatly increase the penetration capabilities of Russian 5.45x39mm caliber weapons, by being able to pierce basic and intermediate ballistic body protections in addition to provide outstanding results against some specialized protection models, despite having a relatively low muzzle velocity compared to other cartridges. However, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.
data.56dff061d2720bb5668b4567 Description: A 5.45x39mm BT gs (GRAU Index - 7BT4) cartridge with a 3.1 gram armor-piercing tracer bullet with a heat-strengthened steel core with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Red). This BT bullet (Bronebóynaya Trassíruyushchaya - "Armor-piercing Tracer") it's an improved version of the used in the 5.45x39 mm T gs cartridge (GRAU Index - 7T3), since the lead core was replaced by one of heat-strengthened steel, providing automatic firearms with penetration capabilities against basic ballistic body protections as well as excellent results against intermediate models, however, due to its design, it has a significant bounce probability off various surfaces.
data.56dff0bed2720bb0668b4567 Description: A 5.45x39mm cartridge with a 3.9 gram lead core full metal jacket (FMJ) bullet in a steel case; intended for hunting, home defense, and target practice. Despite its rudimentary design, it is capable of piercing basic ballistic body protection, besides having a significant stopping power effect.
data.56dff216d2720bbd668b4568 Description: A 5.45x39mm cartridge with a 3.6 gram lead core hollow-point (HP) bullet with a bimetallic semi-jacket in a steel case; intended for hunting, home defense, and target practice. The bullet in this cartridge has an excellent expansion and impact energy that give it outstanding stopping power effects, as well as being able to cause substantial adverse effects on the target after impact, making it a good choice for hunting.
data.56dff2ced2720bb4668b4567 Description: A 5.45x39mm PP gs (GRAU Index - 7N10) cartridge with a 3.5 gram bullet with a heat-strengthened steel core with lead cladding on the tip and bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. The PP bullet (Povýshennoy Probiváyemosti - "Increased Penetration") was designed in the 1990s as an upgraded version of the one used in the 5.45x39mm PS gs cartridge, as a longer and narrower tempered steel core was chosen, allowing it to pierce through basic ballistic body protections as well as some intermediate models, however, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.
data.56dff338d2720bbd668b4569 Description: A 5.45x39mm PRS gs cartridge with a 3.9 gram soft lead core bullet with a bimetallic jacket in a steel case. This PRS bullet (Ponízhennoy Rikoshetíruyushchey Sposóbnosti - "Reduced Ricochet Ability") was designed in the early 2000s to crumble and rapidly lose speed when hitting a solid object in order to substantially reduce collateral damage from ricochets during urban operations carried out by law enforcement agencies and groups from the Ministry of Internal Affairs, thus achieving a considerable stopping power effect on the target at the cost of penetration capabilities, even against basic ballistic protection.
data.56dff3afd2720bba668b4567 Description: A 5.45x39mm PS gs (GRAU Index - 7N6) cartridge with a 3.4 gram steel core bullet with lead cladding on the tip and a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. The PS cartridge (Púlya so Stal'ným serdéchnikom - "Bullet with a Steel core") was introduced into service in 1974 alongside with Soviet 5.45x39mm caliber weaponry, providing the Soviet Army with capabilities to pierce basic ballistic body protections, however, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.
data.56dff421d2720b5f5a8b4567 Description: A 5.45x39mm cartridge with a 3.6 gram lead core soft-point (SP) bullet with a bimetallic semi-jacket in a steel case, intended for hunting, home defense, and target practice. This bullet has a good initial expansion on impact due to the exposure of the lead core at the tip, giving it considerable stopping power effects at the cost of penetration capabilities, even against basic ballistic protection, as well as being able to cause substantial adverse effects on the target after impact.
data.56dff4a2d2720bbd668b456a Description: A 5.45x39mm T gs (GRAU Index - 7T3) cartridge with a 3.2 gram lead core tracer bullet with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Red). This T cartridge (Trassíruyushchaya - "Tracer") was introduced in 1974 alongside with the PS gs cartridge (GRAU Index - 7N6) to provide tracing capabilities to Soviet 5.45x39mm caliber weaponry, as well as being able of piercing basic ballistic body protection, besides having significant stopping power effect. However, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.
data.56dff4ecd2720b5f5a8b4568 Description: A 5.45x39mm US gs (GRAU Index - 7U1) cartridge with a 5.1 gram subsonic bullet with a pointed tungsten carbide core over a lead base with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case with a reduced charge. This US cartridge (Umén'shennoy Skórosti - "Reduced Speed") was designed by TsNIITochMash in the mid-1980s for use in the AKS-74UB and AKS-74UBN models in conjunction with a suppressor, ensuring the weapon's fire cycling and achieving an excellent noise reduction in addition to granting a considerable stopping power effect, but despite the composition of the bullet, it has difficulties piercing basic ballistic body protections and due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.
data.56e0598dd2720bb5668b45a6 Description: The PB pistol (Pistolét Besshúmnyy - "Silenced Pistol", GRAU Index - 6P9) was designed with a two-part suppressor, the main suppressor and a section built into the barrel, which allows the weapon to be operated without problems even without the main suppressor attached, but operating the weapon in this way will not mitigate the sound or muzzle flash. It was intended for army reconnaissance groups and USSR KGB personnel and was introduced into service in 1967. data.56ea6fafd2720b844b8b4593 Description: The Noveske KX3 Flash hider, aka the Burning Pig, is designed to increase reliability in short-barreled members of AR-15 family by increasing backpressure and directing the muzzle blast forward of the shooter. data.56ea70acd2720b844b8b4594 Description: The Hensoldt FF 4-16x56 telescopic sight was developed to deliver maximum performance and high adjustment ranges while maintaining a short optical system. By design, this cartridge provides a considerable stopping power effect as well as causing substantial adverse effects on the target after impact, this is at the cost of penetration capabilities, even against basic body ballistic protection besides having a low muzzle velocity.
data.573602322459776445391df1 Description: A 7.62x25mm Tokarev cartridge with a lead round nose, polymer coated (LRNPC) bullet; intended for sport shooting and hunting. This cartridge provides an outstanding stopping power effect compared to other cartridges of the same caliber used by the military, as it can cause substantial adverse effects on the target after impact, however, its muzzle velocity is lower, not to mention its poor penetration capabilities.
data.5736026a245977644601dc61 Description: A 7.62x25mm Tokarev P gl (GAU Index - 57-N-132) cartridge with a 5.5 gram lead core bullet with a bimetallic jacket in a brass case. This is a rudimentary cartridge that was released alongside the adoption of the TT pistol in the USSR.
data.573603562459776430731618 Description: A 7.62x25mm Tokarev Pst gzh (GAU Index - 57-N-134S) cartridge with a 5.4 gram steel core bullet with a lead cladding and a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. Although this cartridge was created with the intention of neutralizing hostile personnel behind objects with low structural strength, it is currently capable of efficiently piercing basic ballistic body protections as well as some intermediate models at close range.
data.573603c924597764442bd9cb Description: A 7.62x25mm Tokarev PT gzh (GAU Index - 57-T-133) with a 5.8 gram lead core tracer bullet in a bimetallic case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Red). Although this cartridge has an effective range of 100 meters, its tracing capacity greatly exceeds this distance, designed to be used in the PPD, PPS and PPSh submachine guns along with the 7.62x25mm TT Pst gzh cartridge and provide a similar stopping power effect.
data.573718ba2459775a75491131 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov BZhT gzh (GRAU Index - 7N15) cartridge with a 5 gram bullet made of solid hardened steel in a bimetallic case. The bullet in this cartridge has a truncated cone design in order to increase its penetration capabilities against some models of basic ballistic body protection.
data.573719762459775a626ccbc1 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov P gzh (GAU Index - 57-N-181-01) cartridge with a 6.1 gram lead core bullet with a bimetallic jacket in a bimetallic case. This is a rudimentary cartridge that was released alongside the adoption of the PM pistol in the USSR.
data.573719df2459775a626ccbc2 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov PBM gzh (GRAU Index - 7N25) cartridge with a 3.7 gram hardened carbon steel core armor-piercing bullet with a bimetallic semi-jacket in a bimetallic case. This cartridge was designed in the 1990s to increase the penetration capabilities of 9x18 mm PM caliber weapons, and thanks to its high muzzle velocity it is capable of piercing through basic ballistic body protection equipment as well as certain intermediate protection equipment at short distances at the cost of a small increase in recoil.
data.57371aab2459775a77142f22 Description: A 9x18mm PMM PstM gzh (GAU Index - 57-N-181SM, GRAU Index - 7N16) cartridge with a 5.6 gram steel core bullet with a bimetallic jacket in a truncated cone shape, in a bimetallic case. The 9x18mm PMM cartridge is the modernization of the 9x18mm PM cartridge, designed with the intention of increasing its piercing capabilities against basic ballistic body protections, and it has an increased powder charge, making it dangerous to fire in non-compatible weapons. It is intended to be used with the PMM pistol (Makarov Pistol Modernised) and the PP-9 "Klin" submachine gun.
data.57371b192459775a9f58a5e0 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov PPe gzh cartridge with a 7.6 gram lead core hollow-point bullet with a bimetallic semi-jacket, in a bimetallic case. The design of this bullet is based on experiences gained from other 9x18mm PM hollow-point cartridges. The PPe cartridge has a conical hole in its core and the jacket has six notches to improve its expandability on impact, thus achieving a significant stopping power effect.
data.57371e4124597760ff7b25f1 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov PPT gzh (GAU Index - 57-T-181) cartridge with a 3.6 gram lead core tracer bullet with a bimetallic jacket in a bimetallic case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Red). With the arrival of new submachine guns in the 1990s, the Ministry of Internal Affairs became interested in developing ammunition with tracing capabilities greater than 100 meters, in addition to providing stopping power on impact.
data.57371eb62459776125652ac1 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov PRS gs cartridge with a 6.1 gram soft lead core bullet with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. The PRS bullet (Ponízhennoy Rikoshetíruyushchey Sposóbnosti - "Reduced Ricochet Ability") is designed to crumble and rapidly lose speed when hitting a solid object in order to substantially reduce collateral damage from ricochets during urban operations carried out by law enforcement agencies and groups from the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
data.57371f2b24597761224311f1 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov PS gs PPO cartridge with a 6.3 gram lead core bullet with a bimetallic jacket in a truncated cone round-nose shape, in a steel case. The PS gs PPO cartridge was developed due to the need for the Ministry of Internal Affairs to equip law enforcement agencies with a cartridge that had reduced ricochet capabilities in order to minimize collateral damage during urban operations.
data.57371f8d24597761006c6a81 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov PSO gzh cartridge with a 6.1 gram lead core bullet in a bimetallic case; intended for sport shooting and hunting. Rudimentary designed for small game hunting.
data.5737201124597760fc4431f1 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov Pst gzh (GAU Index - 57-N-181S-01) cartridge with a 5.9 gram steel core bullet with a lead cladding and a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. This cartridge was developed right after the adoption of the PM pistol with base on the 9x18mm PM P gzh cartridge to provide a more effective solution against hostile personnel without ballistic body protection at distances of up to 50 meters.
data.5737207f24597760ff7b25f2 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov PSV cartridge with a 7.5 gram hollow-point bullet; intended for sport shooting and hunting. Despite its low muzzle velocity, it has a considerable stopping power effect thanks to its exceptional expansion capability after hitting the target.
data.573720e02459776143012541 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov RG028 gzh cartridge with a 6 gram hollow-point bullet with a cylindrical hardened steel core with lead cladding and a bimetallic semi-jacket, in a bimetallic case. This cartridge was developed specifically for the PM pistol in the late 1970s by order of the KGB to provide a significant stopping power effect and increase its penetration capabilities against some models of basic ballistic body protection at short distances.
data.57372140245977611f70ee91 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov SP7 gzh cartridge with a 5.2 gram expanding bullet with a lead core in a plastic plug with a brass semi-jacket, in a bimetallic case with an enhanced charge. This cartridge was developed by TsNIITochMash in the mid-1980s to provide an outstanding stopping effect at the cost of penetration capabilities, as well as causing substantial adverse effects on the target after impact, and thanks to its increased powder load it can achieve a high muzzle velocity without compromising the weapon or its operator.
data.5737218f245977612125ba51 Description: A 9x18mm Makarov SP8 gzh cartridge with a 3.9 gram frangible hollow-point bullet with a lead core in a plastic plug with a brass semi-jacket, in a bimetallic case with a reduced charge. Developed in the mid-1980s by TsNIITochMash in order to provide a low penetration cartridge to minimize the destruction and over-piercing of objects with low structural strength (for example, during counter-terrorism operations in an aircraft) and still provide a considerable stopping power effect as well as causing substantial adverse effects on the target after impact.

data.57486e672459770abd687134 Description: The original design of OKP sights allows firing from unstable positions in rapidly changing conditions, reduces the operator fatigue, and, if necessary, allows unhindered use of base mechanical sights. The key feature of this sight is a rimless reflector attachment that doesn't block any field of fire sections; instead, reflector is protected by thin and durable visor that is almost un-noticeable when firing. This variant is installed on the dovetail type mount.
data.574d967124597745970e7c94 Description: A Soviet semi-automatic carbine designed by Sergei Simonov for 7.62x39 cartridges and known abroad as SKS-45. Immensely popular both in CIS countries and in the West, this weapon is still in active service in some countries in form of various copies and modifications. This particular model comes from extended storage warehouses of Tula Arms Plant and haven't yet undergone the civilian weapon normalization procedure.

data.57513fcc24597720a31c09a6 Description: Multifruit and multivitamin juice can be confusing tastewise, but it sure is healthy.

data.5751435d24597720a27126d1 Description: Max Energy energy drink, designed like a battery, but different in contents - regular caffeine, sugar, and flavoring.
data.57514643245977207f2c2d09 Description: TarCola is a widely spread cola-flavored soft drink produced by a local drinks manufacturer before the conflict.
data.575146b724597720a27126d5 Description: A 1 litre box of milk that mysteriously survived until now. Drink at your own discretion.
data.5751487e245977207e26a315 Description: Emelya rye croutons with assorted flavors were a favorite snack for kids and "cracking open a cold one while watching movies" enjoyers. Although, these days you won't find either the kids or any movies in Tarkov.

data.5751496424597720a27126da Description: Hot Rod, though being the most recognizable energy drink in the world, is not much more powerful than its counterparts. The standards are the same for all.
data.5751a89d24597722aa0e8db0 Description: The famous Vietnamese "Golden Star" balm, also known as Cao Sao Vang, is made from essential oils like Camphor, Menthol, Peppermint, Cajuput, all mixed into vaseline. A small amount of the balm is applied to the sub-district and rubbing of the skin: for headache - the temples and the nape of the neck, with a cold - under the nostrils, the common cold - in the chest, back, abdomen, insect bites - on the place of bite. External use only!
data.5755356824597772cb798962 Description: The AI-2 medkit was developed as a standard service first aid kit for various defense and law enforcement agencies and civil defense forces of USSR. In case of all-out conflict with the use of weapons of mass destruction it should have been distributed to the population of the affected and surrounding areas.
data.5755383e24597772cb798966 Description: Vaseline, or, more precisely, petroleum jelly, is a versatile ointment used for a number of purposes where its water insulation and lubrication properties are required, for instance, for treating small cuts and burns, coating corrosion-prone items or lubricating gear that requires non-acidic lubricants.
data.576165642459773c7a400233 Description: A semi-automatic 12-gauge shotgun with a folding stock, equipped with a firing mechanism safety lock that only allows firing from extended stock position. Features a short 430mm barrel.
data.576167ab2459773cad038c43 Description: A standard-issue threading protection tube for SOK-12.
data.576169e62459773c69055191 Description: Sb.7-1 is a standard polymer handguard with a sling swivel, installs on SOK-12 and SOK-12S.
data.57616a9e2459773c7a400234 Description: A 5-round Sb.5 polymer plastic magazine for the SOK-12 and compatible weapons, intended for use with 12/76 or 12/70 shells.
data.57616c112459773cce774d66 Description: A standard-issue Sb.0-2 dust cover for Saiga 12, manufactured by Izhmash.
data.57616ca52459773c69055192 Description: A folding polymer AK-styled stock for SOK-12, manufactured by Izhmash.
data.576a581d2459771e7b1bc4f1 Description: The PYa MP-443 (Pistolét Yarýgina MP-443 - "Yarygin Pistol MP-443", GRAU Index - 6P35) widely known as "Grach" is a Russian semiautomatic pistol chambered in 9x19 mm. It was designed by Vladimir Yarygin in the 1990s and adopted as a standard sidearm by the Russian military, law enforcement agencies, and special units of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. It features a high capacity magazine and can be equipped with the Zenit B-8 mount to install additional attachments beneath the barrel.
data.576a5ed62459771e9c2096cb Description: A standard 18-round 9x19 magazine for the MP-443 pistol.
data.576a63cd2459771e796e0e11 Description: A standard service pistol grip for MP-443 pistols manufactured by Izhmekh.
data.576a7c512459771e796e0e17 Description: The B-8 rail mount can be installed on Yarygin pistols (MP-443 "Grach" and its civilian version MP-446 "Viking") for use with additional attachments, like Zenit Klesch-2P tactical flashlight/laser. Manufactured by Zenit.
data.576fd4ec2459777f0b518431 Description: The PSO-1M2-1 military grade optical sniper scope, manufactured by BelOMO. This scope is designed for precision sight fire with Special Sniper Rifle (VSS) and Dragunov Sniper Rifle (SVD) on the variety of targets with 4x magnification and 6 degree FOV.
data.577d128124597739d65d0e56 Description: This base from Burris allows to mount the compact FastFire Series Sights to Weaver or Picatinny-style rails.
data.577d141e24597739c5255e01 Description: Light and tough, the FastFire series collimator puts a clear bright red dot on your target to give you an immediate speed and accuracy advantage. Can be used as a primary sight or mounted on top of an existing sight.
data.577e1c9d2459773cd707c525 Description: Office-grade paper for printers and copiers, it can nevertheless be used for writing as well, just like any paper.

data.57838ad32459774a17445cd2 Description: VSS (Vintovka Sniperskaya Specialnaya - "Special Sniper Rifle") is an integrally suppressed sniper rifle, designed in the 80s in the TsNIITochMash institute for the needs of special-purpose teams and task forces.
