data.68ea5b6bcc7c899f90fa5168: A.P.: I understand your concerns! I don’t have all the information myself, but I’m confident that our new partners will be just as reliable as USEC personnel.
data.68ea5b6e2bff0736c56a09f2: A.P.: TerraGroup has always prioritized security and will entrust our evacuation only to true professionals.
data.68ea5b71a0dfaf2f689331f9: A.P.: Speaking of the evacuation… In 13 hours and 47 minutes, all TerraGroup facilities must be vacated. Yes, this is the first time we’re working under such a rush, but there’s no other way.
data.68ea5b739da8063244c3c72c: A.P.: I’ve received the codes, "Braun" and "Chernigov" included… Also from Lisbon. So by the time the timer runs out, no one should be left here!
data.68ea5b73a7a41ecce08c4f6e: A.P.: I’ll be evacuating last. Well, not just me. Korneev, are you here?
data.68ebc308a4c32e2d12d4fefa: A.P.: Good. Once everything is sealed, we’ll head to the Health Resort.
data.68ea5b74ea2509d99a698972: A.P.: I understand, colleagues. It’s hard to realize that all production must be shut down. We won’t be able to take microbiology at all, just the data and parameters…
data.68ebc32be4c53dcc9bd8b22d: Shout from the audience: How are we supposed to leave all this? We spent a year setting up the lab!
data.68ebc33fca247ad6cc115f20: A.P.: Galina Petrovna, calm down! Everything will be fine at the new location.
data.68ea5b76d221e86990817609: A.P.: Alright, one more thing, this is important! Ahem, excuse me, I have to take this…
data.68ea5b7666c1da892bdcfc33: A.P.: Hello? Yes, "Schliss 14"… Already… Yes… Wait, right now? Understood… Give me two minutes, I’ll find a spot.
data.68ea5b778aa1929224c560fd: A.P.: Friends! It's an extremely urgent call, I need to step away. My apologies. I’ll be back soon.
data.68889263ea36baf84d085540 Description: A tape from the lecture hall recording one of the TerraGroup meetings.
data.68b6da4fa4c6b15d3a5aa856: Cult Victim: The last tape ran out. I didn’t think it would happen this fast. Alright, I’ll make this quick.
data.68b6da643eac094f2a6db325: Cult Victim: Anyway, those guys… those guys in hoods… They’re watching me. I just found a note stuck in my door.
data.68b6da89958758ab3bdd1f10: Cult Victim: You know, between the door and the frame—whatever! It said something about the "Eye of the World", that I look through it and it looks back at me… The Priests called me the chosen one!
data.68b6dac1931001229ba59040: Cult Victim: I need to run. I’m recording this on my way to the train station. I have to get out of here, doesn’t matter where or how anymore!
data.688893c5a030f9346505e6d5 Description: An audio tape found among the personal belongings of the victim in the cultists' torture chamber. It seems the owner was chosen deliberately.
data.68bfe3ea49ce213ef5bbe91d: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.
data.68bfe485ab69c3165dbe2666: Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909.
data.68bfe4b2f6c2fbe0b6f830c1: Courier: I was supposed to deliver urgent mail to Norvinsk, but the roads are fu- busy, so I’m going to be delayed.
data.68889451ad1e91bfa40db8fd Description: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the first call from May 11.
data.68bfe54cea9d42e405c48978: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.
data.68bfe58e6ee688ea3231200c: Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909.
data.68bfe5a2a4df6e8c4d32f43f: Courier: Things are way worse than I thought. Half the roads are blocked. I have no idea if I’ll make it out of Tarkov today.
data.68bfe5c79ed44eab76e9691c: Courier: Let the recipient know not to hang up on the call center.
data.688894da0bc983c31509f32a Description: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the second call from May 11.
data.68bfe8209001207c19920342: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.
data.68bfe82fea18902e3dbb117a: Courier: This is a complete clusterfuck! They're stopping everyone at the checkpoint, the line's already kilometers long.
data.68bfe85b2a0d3361aff78d80: Courier: The truck driver in front of me started arguing with them, and they fucking shot him! Are you fucking hearing this?!
data.68bfe87b6da55cc254d91668: Courier: A stray bullet hit my car! I almost fucking died! You know what, I don't get paid for this. I’m getting outta here on foot to my family.
data.68bfe8a843ed244d2dbfef97: Courier: I’m leaving the car, all the parcels are inside. Life’s more important. If you send someone - the key… the key is under the wheel.
data.68889504f6192726ac07c66c Description: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the third call from May 11.
data.68ea496b680155845750f646: Priest: The new masters of the world are already here, and the process has begun… The New World has started to take shape, and the Wardens have already been chosen.
data.68ea4982dbbc029cd8cba974: Priest: Know that the Eye of the World has been watching you for a long time, and all… all your deeds are imprinted in the memory that the Wardens will carry from the old world into the new. Soon, it will be the only thing of value.
data.68ea49bc10d60054c4314ba6: Priest: I knew you would come here. It was all foretold. We awaited the Blind One who would help us prepare everything for the Riders of the Arrival. And in you… we found him.
data.68ea49e3857888888b31a46b: Priest: Behold the power of The Unheard before it is too late…
data.688895322f6b5b76380e6af5 Description: An audio tape that somehow ended up in the safe at station 14-4 KORD. Either someone slipped it in unnoticed when the server room’s cooling system was activated, or they already knew what would happen.
data.6888954ba66a069e0405a9aa Name: SVT-40 Addley Precision Smith-less Scope Mount
data.6888954ba66a069e0405a9aa Description: A scope mount designed for the SVT-40. Manufactured by Addley Precision.
data.68ea5cf776c0ede0d9c5a817: Voevoda: To the commander of the Gnezdo base. Reporting. After the combat task was completed, someone detonated an explosive.
data.68ea5d024573d2106c48247b: Voevoda: We have casualties among USEC operators and civilians. One of ours is critically wounded, the rest have light injuries. Assistance required. I repeat, assistance required!
data.6888958794cca0a80b070ae9 Description: An audio tape recording the conversations between the Gnezdo outpost fighters and the Bogatyr squad.
data.68ea5d7dc9d0d9a159b983b7: Voevoda: Ahem… I never kept a diary. Thought it was a stupid idea. But now I feel like I should share my thoughts with someone.
data.68ea5d80f539fdd7d8da5714: Voevoda: The Bogatyr squad got into a bad mess. Some of my boys are dead, others wounded. Maybe that is why I keep thinking this is not an accident.
data.68ea5d893da1b5dc69d7c4f8: Voevoda: This is not only happening here. Tarkov, conflicts in the Middle East, hunger, poverty, global warming…
data.68ea5d89efd6a99ffab2bfe2: Voevoda: People seem to be going mad! But strangely, it’s very sudden. A decent family man turns and shoots his little girls.
data.68ea5d8bdb4e6054df0aa670: Voevoda: It's the same here. Tarkov used to be a prosperous city. People came here on purpose. Then… the sore burst and it spilled out…
data.68ea5d905c698056dbe453c0: Voevoda: What if it’s the Earth itself trying to rid itself of the filth, this humanity virus? People only harm this planet. Maybe this is the end for all of us?
data.68ea5d97c0a7439dc36ee052: Voevoda: I do not know. But those thoughts just keep coming. End transmission.
data.6888965ac122cae7a20765fa Description: This recording seems to capture one of Voevoda’s reflections on the causes of the Tarkov conflict.
data.68ea3f2c338b34173ffabfcd: TerraGroup Scientist: This is Nikolay Voronenko speaking. The Labyrinth is the worst technically equipped TerraGroup facility, we have already lost contact with headquarters. Perhaps one of the test subjects cut the cable…
data.68ea3f4de3134607b894de76: TerraGroup Scientist: The facility was stormed by BEAR mercenaries. To defend the Labyrinth I had to release the test subjects from groups 3 and 12.
data.68ea3fadc9a693d7baf38672: TerraGroup Scientist: Judging by the sounds, only the test subjects are left outside now, I can’t hear any of the BEARs.
data.68ea3fee8e6687c4bb654b12: TerraGroup Scientist: The experiments carried out in the Labyrinth are too important and too dangerous to lose the results. So I gathered all the facility documentation into a folder and threw it into the drain.
data.68ea400f95d9f79ba8156536: TerraGroup Scientist: I don’t know if I’ll make it to the evacuation point… but during the chase I managed to grab a pistol from one of the BEARs. It will be a last resort.
data.688897992f6b5b76380e6af9 Description: The final recording of a TerraGroup scientist who locked himself in the Labyrinth observation room.
data.68ea6839c23ff215e422b819: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: …so. There are no exact dates yet. We think everything will start in about… three months. You and your, um, team should move in right after our signal.
data.68ea68bdc7be47262d193787: Chepyga: And the cops? I’m not sending my boys to their deaths for nothing.
data.68ea68c0a9ada0a918d84778: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: The mayor is aware and will take care of it. The pay is good, considering all your risks. Sponsors pay in foreign currency, just the way we like it.
data.68ea68d872f730061c4681e4: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Only this time you'll be able to take control of the whole city. Once the dust settles, obviously.
data.68ea68d82ea1b09e812f9154: Chepyga: Shit's getting serious. There'll be a lots of bodies.
data.68ea68d949c007685b23bdd5: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: There will be a lot of blood spilled, but not yours and not ours, assuming we act together.
data.68ea68dad6cd9377c08aa7a9: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Equipment, weapons, medical supplies — everything will be provided. Your tasks are tough, we won’t leave you without support.
data.68ea68e9b219ba434c5e2b53: Chepyga: We’ll need more people. And waste a couple of local big shots beforehand so they don’t start nosing around. It’ll be harder if we don't do it soon enough.
data.68ea68ec6dd81f45f0f880f1: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: If you handle it cleanly, I’ll help cover it up. After things heat up, we won’t have trouble finding volunteers.
data.68ea68edb4edf66d6749b6ff: Chepyga: Aight. When do we get the guns?
data.68ea68ee3c16c4ccfedd5926: Chepyga: Hey you! The fuck you doing here?! Come here!
data.688897e094cca0a80b070aed Description: An audio tape prepared by Kozlov for Anastasia. According to Kozlov’s letters, it contains irrefutable proof of the city administration’s ties to the local criminal underworld.
data.691343ce4ded41ee2bea97ff: Squad Leader: The explosion knocked out all our electronics.
data.69134497768350d6a4cedbc4: Squad Leader: I repeat. Our comms are out!
data.68b6dc8e96312975395afe50: Squad Leader: Operation is canceled! Fall back to the evacuation points on your own!
data.68889a2f94cca0a80b070af1 Name: BEAR commander's audio tape labeled "For the BEARs"
data.68889a2f94cca0a80b070af1 Description: An audio tape containing important instructions left by our squad’s commander.
data.69133e6503f523df53ea3baf: Squad Leader: To all USEC... To all USEC units! Blast killed all...
data.68b6dc376444a29985459601: Squad Leader: Blast killed all our electronics — no comm with HQ.
data.68b6dc38871052ba31637157: Squad Leader: We have lost control of the facility. Evacuate through Exfil Three towards the port... Exfil Three!
data.68ea5149598a79eedb06884c: Squad Leader: Expect enemy contact, proceed with caution. Any non-USEC individuals are to be considered hostile!
data.691340c1bb5c24fdd4327cc7: Squad Leader: Defend yourselves. Use sound judgment.
data.68889aab3fcaf13e48003ba7 Name: USEC commander's audio tape labeled "For the USEC"
data.68889aab3fcaf13e48003ba7 Description: An audio tape containing important instructions left by our squad’s commander.
data.68b6dbf69a46a09a1c755f05: USEC Operative: Commander! How much... How much longer do you reckon we'll be stuck here?
data.68b6dbfac7e0a00e1b02ec36: USEC Squad Leader: For as long as they tell us to. TerraGroup still has a fuckload of unclosed facilities in Tarkov.
data.68b6dbfa3a0b2378a39c6f71: USEC Operative: You think they’ll manage to pull everything out on time? Even with their resources, it sounds impossible.
data.68b6dbfa028de235e5884fe8: USEC Squad Leader: Let them set their priorities themselves. We’ve already got our hands full babysitting HVIs and hauling out TerraGroup’s docs.
data.68b6dbfae852a369ef69cff3: USEC Operative: But still, even if everything is moved out, there will be hundreds of digital drives left behind… There’s no way to evacuate something like that in war conditions.
data.68b6dbfc0a786dba6c327834: USEC Squad Leader: They're not gonna extract everything, okay? I heard TerraGroup has some kind of weapon that wipes data from the systems. All of it.
data.68b6dbfcc931094cdde643ca: USEC Operative: Like an EMP? Surely they’re gonna give us a heads-up, right? It would screw all our coordination.
data.68ea55505b158349b62f392b: USEC Squad Leader: Why would they hide this from us? Even if they do end up using this thing, it'll only be after we're evacuated.
data.68ea55514f5e2232e04de6e5: USEC Squad Leader: Without our PMC support, they wouldn't last long — they have no one but us.
data.68ea5552705a83548ab21c35: USEC Operative: What about those “contractors” we transferred the HVIs to? They looked quite serious. No, shady too. No insignias, no patches… Who are they anyway?
data.68ea5554bb3c96a1b0486d78: USEC Squad Leader: There is no info on them from the HQ, so clearly we shouldn't get involved in that shit. They might be linked to that specialist guy over at the lighthouse.
data.68ea55540998610ed57006a4: USEC Squad Leader: Or perhaps they're just an escort crew from outside the border — our guys are stretched thin here. Either way, we can't trust them.
data.68ea55554c65adb6ac6ff1cd: USEC Operative: Makes you wonder how fast TerraGroup would’ve been screwed up without us involved…
data.68ea5556764900cda357fdac: USEC Operative: Especially now, when even some of our own commanders are straying away from their orders…
data.68ea555862ec9eed52f766f8: USEC Squad Leader: Listen, watch your mouth! Any other situation, and I'd have you deployed somewhere far worse!
data.69134af1579037fde7cd1e14: USEC Squad Leader: So shut up. SHUT UP!

data.6a024f1bd301c5e32972746c: Survivor: So… if I can’t control this, then I must at least continue observation.
data.6a02545758e6be929aaa4686: Survivor: I am Grigory Altman, supervisor responsible for sample storage aboard the icebreaker “Boreas”. The vessel was…
data.6a025470218d5c1a5bf7143f: Grigory Altman: …was attacked by mercenaries in Tarkov waters. During the assault, sample containers connected to projects TG-Ci and TG-y were damaged.
data.6a02548cc8fb634071d20726: Grigory Altman: In accordance with containment protocol, the laboratory was isolated from adjacent compartments.
data.6a02549b5ba70587f1d882b1: Grigory Altman: I remained inside and administered protective compounds as a precaution against possible contamination.
data.6a0254c11853e610201ab1ef: Grigory Altman: On the fourth day I recorded elevated cortisol levels, coughing, and mild itching. Increased dosage of the injected medication, observing improvement.
data.6a0329c11251309f8fd0af9d: Grigory Altman: It is impossible to fully stop the leak or replace the damaged sample containers. I continue daily measurements and it seems…
data.6a032b4718888d1ba3298dd8: Grigory Altman: …It seems I managed to arrange evacuation to a secure location where I can isolate the samples and continue observation.
data.6a032b8db0f782913ecaa034: Grigory Altman: It’s critical to complete this before I enter the paranoia stage…

data.69cfef0d6242b966d40803e7 Description: “Redut-M” is a modified version of the well-proven Redut body armor, which is in service of special units of the FSB. The vest is based on advanced technologies in the field of individual armor. Due to the optimized form of armor elements and the outer cover with a special damping-ventilation system, the Redut M armored vest has excellent functional qualities, which facilitates active actions, including those associated with the use of vehicles and in confined spaces. Black version.
data.69cfff5920eac4535609a008 Description: An improved lightweight version of the standard plate carrier manufactured by Stich Profi. A-TACS FG version.
data.69cfff99cb69530af90a8279 Description: An improved lightweight version of the standard plate carrier manufactured by Stich Profi. Coyote color version.
data.69d26ff4b855150a70092b8c Description: The Gladiator-S body armor by FORT, customized by the Arena Champion nicknamed JP. Since his very first appearance in the Arena as a gladiator, he never even thought of washing the blood off it. Why would he? It’s a symbol of strength.
data.69d27591df93e6952a031c84 Description: A specialized body armor developed for the FSB’s Special Purpose Center, featuring high functionality and modularity. The lightweight version is designed to provide maximum mobility while protecting vital organs. This black version has been customized by one of the Arena fighters.
data.69d27ebeb855150a70092ba3 Description: A specialized body armor developed for the FSB’s Special Purpose Center, featuring high functionality and modularity. The lightweight version is designed to provide maximum mobility while protecting vital organs. MultiCam version.
data.69d28cdc274c032dd804afe0 Description: A specialized body armor developed for the FSB’s Special Purpose Center, featuring high functionality and modularity. MultiCam version.
data.69d36347705756116e0a901c Description: Taking its name from an Old Norse Viking term for a lightning raid, Strandhögg was one of the first formalized battle tactics to use covert infiltrators in advance of an actual raiding operation. Strandhögg was a tactical game-changer in its time, just like the technological advances First Spear is bringing forward in this line of plate carriers. MultiCam Black version.
data.69d37050705756116e0a9037 Description: The Haley Strategic D3CRX Combat chest rig is one of the most respected PMC rig systems. Ease and comfort of use are supported by the presence of the optimal number of pouches.
data.69d3708c8d8009073d0a9df4 Description: A specialized body armor developed for the FSB’s Special Purpose Center, featuring high functionality and modularity. Gray version.
data.69d39aacf1954acdb3083285 Description: A reward for participation in Season 2 BattlePass “Casus Belli”. Rumor has it, it contains items somehow connected to the Arena Champion known as JP. Designed for the most reckless gladiators and can only be opened within the Arena.
data.69d3c156cdeff2f448010e2e Description: The Razor electronic ear muffs feature an ultra low-profile design and a rubberized coating for added durability and comfort, also providing optimal hearing protection. Manufactured by Walker's. A version for the true gladiators.
data.69d46480fe02b60eed07a402 Description: A quality balaclava with a special technological material. But we do not need it for some gimmicky materials. We need it to look tactical and dripped out with the Swedish M90 camouflage.
data.69dd0de23dfe95d9e70b5ebb Description: A mysterious currency that appeared in Tarkov after the Contract Wars had already begun. The motto stamped on the coin refers to a certain well-known company... A rare item, prized by everyone without exception.
data.69e2441a18cb3157560855ec Name: Spiritus Systems LV-119 Plate Carrier (MultiCam Black)
data.69e2441a18cb3157560855ec Description: A highly customizable modular plate carrier by Spiritus Systems, built for maximum comfort in combat. This MultiCam Black version setup is built by a Black Division operative with the callsign The Wedge.
data.69e24f4f9e6ca1b32508bfbc Name: Team Wendy EXFIL helmet cover (MultiCam Black)
data.69e24f4f9e6ca1b32508bfbc Description: A helmet cover for Team Wendy EXFIL series helmets. The MultiCam Black camouflage is intended for night-time operations.
data.69f07893e761ac1c200ae15b Description: A non-lethal gas grenade containing an irritant agent. Active emission lasts 20–40 seconds, while dispersion and dissipation depend on environmental conditions.
data.69f9d319c906cd16da03b374 Description: A coin bank shaped like a cat, suspiciously resembling the pet of a certain operator from Colorado.
data.69f9d547b98cc4120608692a Description: This CD contains a collection of D&B hits by an Oregon DJ who visited Tarkov many times during his tours.
data.69f9d60b5de6674f08060f2a Description: Rumor has it that these floppy disks contain all the information needed to survive in Tarkov. What’s unclear is how such a valuable amount of data could fit onto a 1.44 MB disk.

data.6a317b9692cfdcddcb02a58e Description:
Rumor has it that TerraGroup keeps a personnel file on nearly every PMC operator. Judging by these documents, the rumors are true.

Can be found on: 
- Reserve
- Lighthouse
- Icebreaker
data.6a31807f17005505b70d5827 Description:
Financial reports from TerraGroup and its affiliated companies. There's bound to be plenty of inconsistencies and evidence hidden inside, but are you really willing to spend hours of your life reading dry financial paperwork?

Can be found on: 
- Customs
- Streets of Tarkov
- Interchange
data.6a3181f178450ec91c0ea1aa Description:
Documentation from Tarkov Infraline. The company officially specialized in road construction, but these blueprints clearly have nothing to do with transportation infrastructure.

Can be found on:
- Factory
- Reserve
- Customs
data.6a31824878450ec91c0ea1ae Description:
Blueprints and technical documentation belonging to TerraGroup. For convenience, all of the data has also been backed up onto a disk.

Can be found on: 
- Interchange
- Factory
- The Labyrinth
data.6a31828557705071410ca00e Description:
Documents detailing tests of various experimental compounds from TerraGroup-controlled laboratories. It's surprising they've managed to remain in Tarkov at all.

Can be found on: 
- Shoreline
- Woods
- Icebreaker
data.6a3182b72fd891345e047eef Description:
Documentation issued to every new TerraGroup employee upon signing. It contains both useful information and the obligatory, mind-numbing office rules like how to chip in for a coworker's birthday gift.

Can be found on:
- Ground Zero
- Streets of Tarkov
- The Lab
data.6a3182dc6cd8de21cf0a3a7d Description:
Medical records containing research findings. Many of them are ethically questionable, yet remarkably successful in every other regard. Truth is in the eye of the beholder.

Can be found on: 
- The Lab
- Ground Zero
- The Labyrinth
data.6a31830dde69ceafd805afa0 Description:
Operating manuals for TerraGroup equipment. Essential for anyone who'd rather not lose a few fingers or break machinery worth millions of dollars. Or for anyone looking to make a tidy profit.

Can be found on: 
- Shoreline
- Woods
- Lighthouse
data.6a3183258f113efdb7093622 Description:
Classified information that somehow survived against all odds. Arguably the most valuable thing left in Tarkov.

A unique document that can be used in place of any other document required for the Battle Pass.

Available from the Expansion Hub.
